caption:
Before you share that news, read this verse

Allah tells the believers that if an evildoer brings them news, they should verify it, so they do not harm people unknowingly and end up regretting it. Today one tap can spread a rumor to thousands.

Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:6

Pause and verify the next thing you are about to forward

#verifynews #thinkbeforeyoushare #socialmediaadab #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: O you who believe, if an evildoer brings you some news, verify it, lest you harm a people unknowingly, then you become regretful for what you did (Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:6)
